name: Side Quest
source:
In another world, there lives three legendary heroes. Alva, a well endowed elf ranger whose arrow always hits their mark. Dusk, a cunning, brooding, and impulsive rogue whose true identity is still unknown. And finally, [Insert Player Name Here], the courageous leader who wields a mighty sword and has a strong sense of justice. Together, after many trials and tribulations, they toppled the demon lord and saved the world. That is, until years later, the demon lord's son came out of hiding to finish what his father started. 

With great, dark magic, he captured the princess of the land, whose beauty was unmatched by any living being to ever exist before. Now the three legendary heroes, and their cute and marketable sidekick creature, Chomp, are being called upon once again to defeat the new demon lord and save the princess from his evil clutches!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4367910/Side_Quest/]Steam[/url]]
